description: Public support_critical_regions_only tree-support gate. The fixture keeps a 1 mm ordinary shelf overhang and a disjoint 11 mm cap overhang carried by a build-plate stem; public support-fill segments are classified in model-space windows inside the configured printable area.

mutants.description: Ignoring the public critical-regions gate retains the ordinary shelf overhang, so the enabled row must violate its zero ordinary-overhang witness.
Dropping the retained cantilever set removes the disjoint cap witness, so the enabled row must violate its positive cantilever-support witness.
